title: session-load's 5-rep record of the real intake hook, run after its tool landed
goal: kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv holds a 5-rep record of python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --arms A --intake-real (case 'idle hook intake real', rows cpu_s, wall_s and spawns), run once ST-6zg57xiu's tool commit is on origin/main so its rows name that commit

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, subprocess
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'report', '--check'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('report --check', p.returncode, p.stdout[-400:])
rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv', encoding='utf-8')) if r['scenario'] == 'session-load']
for m in ('cpu_s', 'wall_s', 'spawns'):
    assert [r for r in rows if r['case'] == 'idle hook intake real' and r['arm'] == 'A' and r['metric'] == m and r['runs'] == '5'], ('no 5-run record row of the unpinned intake hook', m)

clauses.clause: kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv holds a 5-rep record of python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --arms A --intake-real (case 'idle hook intake real', rows cpu_s, wall_s and spawns), run once ST-6zg57xiu's tool commit is on origin/main so its rows name that commit

notes: Split from ST-6zg57xiu by the operator's answer to its gate land (2026-10-28): the tool lands without record rows, since the landing rebase rewrites the tool commit's sha; this item records the rows once that sha is final on origin/main. Check 0 is ST-6zg57xiu's former check 1.
